# Test fixtures

Real TomTom responses (Search API v2 `nearbySearch`, `chargingAvailability`, October 2026) with their **structure kept as-is** and their content anonymized: station names, addresses, phone numbers, URLs, positions and identifiers are fictional. `irve_tabular.json` is a real response of the data.gouv.fr IRVE tabular API (all columns kept), with operators, contacts, identifiers, addresses and positions replaced.

Do not commit raw API responses.
